title: Magic
summary: Magic is one of the primary abilities of a Seeker and allows the user to cast a variety of spells or powers. Amulets, as well as other artifacts, often are infused with various forms of magical properties. Such magic spells have a variety of uses and effects to affect either the caster or another target.

sections.heading: Blood Spiral Magic
sections.wikitext: Spells used by the [[Blood Spiral]] tend to be a darker form of magic and focus on the manipulation of shadows and darkness. A similar type of spells are used by members of [[the Organization]], although those spells do not tend to have as dark a nature and are usually weaker. most of their spells are used to invoke fear

sections.heading: Spell Classes
sections.wikitext:
Powerful Seekers may set magical traps to protect valuable artifacts, and these protections can even last for centuries. Powerful artifacts may be protected with a curse which only a powerful, strong-willed Seeker will be able to break. Although a safeguard by nature, these traps tend to have very adverse effects against intruders.

*[[:Category:Anti-Magic spells|Anti-Magic]] – Anti-Magic spells are used to negate, disrupt, suppress, or counter other forms of magic, including enemy spells, magical effects, and enchanted traps.

*[[:Category:Conjuring spells|Conjuring]] – Conjuring spells allow Seekers to summon Titans, magical constructs, or physical manifestations of magical energy, often bringing entities or objects into existence.

*[[:Category:Healing spells|Healing]] – Healing spells restore health, mend physical injuries, or revive living beings. Some may also stabilize a Seeker or Titan after extreme damage.

*[[:Category:Illusory spells|Illusory]] – Illusory spells create false images, disguises, or deceptive environments that mislead enemies by manipulating perception rather than reality itself.

*[[:Category:Mental spells|Mental]] – Mental spells directly affect the mind, influencing thoughts, emotions, memories, or willpower. While some overlap with illusions, Mental spells act on cognition rather than the senses alone.

*[[:Category:Mobility spells|Mobility]] – Mobility spells enhance movement or positioning, allowing Seekers to move faster, leap further, cling to surfaces, fly, swim, or otherwise traverse environments beyond normal physical limits.

*[[:Category:Offensive spells|Offensive]] – Offensive spells are used primarily in combat to damage, overpower, or defeat enemies through direct magical force or destructive effects.

*[[:Category:Portal spells|Portal]] – Portal spells manipulate space and distance, enabling teleportation, dimensional travel, or the creation of gateways between locations.

*[[:Category:Power-Up spells|Power-Up]] – Power-Up spells provide a Seekers or Titans with a boost of energy, increasing their power, effectiveness, or duration in the face of exhaustion. 

*[[:Category:Protective spells|Protective]] – Protective spells create barriers, shields, or defensive effects that guard against attacks, environmental hazards, or magical threats.

*[[:Category:Restrictive spells|Restrictive]] – Restrictive spells limit or control an enemy’s movement or actions by binding, immobilizing, slowing, or entangling targets.

*[[:Category:Sensory spells|Sensory]] – Sensory spells enhance, alter, or interfere with the senses, such as sight, hearing, or spatial awareness, either to gain information or disorient opponents.

*[[:Category:Utility spells|Utility]] – Utility spells serve practical, situational, or non-combat purposes, including problem-solving, environmental interaction, object manipulation, or support functions.

full_text:
Magic is one of the primary abilities of a Seeker and allows the user to cast a variety of spells or powers. Amulets, as well as other artifacts, often are infused with various forms of magical properties. Such magic spells have a variety of uses and effects to affect either the caster or another target.

== Blood Spiral Magic ==
Spells used by the Blood Spiral tend to be a darker form of magic and focus on the manipulation of shadows and darkness. A similar type of spells are used by members of the Organization, although those spells do not tend to have as dark a nature and are usually weaker. most of their spells are used to invoke fear

== Casterwill Magic ==
Spells used by the Casterwill family tend to require a vast amount of training and focus on the manipulation of light and life. They are antithetical to the spells used by the Blood Spiral.
